//setup: GitHub Copilot repo-level hooks. Copilot CLI + cloud agent load .github/hooks/*.json. Uses the 'http' hook type (POSTs the event JSON directly, no shell/curl needed) so the X-User-Email header can be attached via 'headers' + 'allowedEnvVars' without shell-syntax ambiguity across platforms. Requires COPILOT_HOOK_ALLOW_LOCALHOST=1 in the environment Copilot runs in (plain http is otherwise refused except to localhost/127.*/[::1] with that flag set), and a USER_EMAIL environment variable so events are attributed to you instead of landing as 'unknown'.
//localApi: Start the Function App with ./scripts/run-functions.ps1 (or the Aspire AppHost). If the port differs, update the URL in every entry below.
